gloss: hitting against a wall; solo practice

definitions.gloss: hitting against a wall; wall practice
definitions.explanation: practicing a ball sport by hitting or throwing a ball against a wall, typically done alone as training

definitions.gloss: talking to oneself; brainstorming alone; bouncing ideas off a wall
definitions.explanation: figuratively, the act of working through ideas or problems without a real conversation partner, as if hitting a ball against a wall

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{壁打|かべう}ちで{練習|れんしゅう}している。
examples.english: I practice by hitting against a wall every day.

examples.japanese: テニスの{壁打|かべう}ちは{一人|ひとり}でもできるいい{練習法|れんしゅうほう}だ。
examples.english: Wall hitting in tennis is a good practice method you can do alone.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}がいないときは{壁打|かべう}ちでフォームを{確認|かくにん}するようにしている。
examples.english: When I don't have a partner, I check my form by practicing against a wall.

examples.japanese: AIと{壁打|かべう}ちしてみた。
examples.english: I tried bouncing ideas off an AI.

examples.japanese: アイデアの{壁打|かべう}ちに{付|つ}き{合|あ}ってくれない？
examples.english: Would you help me brainstorm some ideas?

examples.japanese: {企画|きかく}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する{前|まえ}に、{同僚|どうりょう}と{壁打|かべう}ちして{内容|ないよう}を{練|ね}った。
examples.english: Before submitting the proposal, I bounced ideas off a colleague and refined the content.

notes:
Originally a sports term for solo practice by hitting a ball against a wall (tennis, squash, baseball). In recent years, the figurative sense of brainstorming or testing ideas has become very common in business and tech contexts, especially with the rise of AI chatbots being used as a "wall" to bounce ideas off of.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁打|かべう}ちの{相手|あいて}: brainstorming partner (literally "wall-hitting partner")
- {壁打|かべう}ち{練習|れんしゅう}: wall-hitting practice
- AIと{壁打|かべう}ちする: to brainstorm with AI
- {壁打|かべう}ちに{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to help someone brainstorm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ブレインストーミング: brainstorming — the English loanword, used for structured group ideation
- {素振|すぶ}り: practice swings — solo practice of swinging a bat or racket without a ball
- {自問自答|じもんじとう}: self-questioning — asking and answering one's own questions internally
